newsitem.title: USA: PH Group sees 1997 sales over $14 mln.
newsitem.headline: PH Group sees 1997 sales over $14 mln.

text.p: PH Group Inc said on Monday that it expects 1997 sales to exceed $14 million, up from $9.1 million for 1996.
PH Group reported a second quarter profit of $0.18 per share, compared to a loss of $0.02 for the same period a year ago.
Second quarter 1997 sales totaled $3.1 million, and for the six-month period PH Group had $5.3 million in sales, the company said in a news release.
For the first half of 1996, sales were $3.8 million.
